roleTitle: Senior Product Designer - AI / Agentic Workflows

job.roleTitle: Senior Product Designer - AI / Agentic Workflows
job.location: Fully remote; candidates in a Samsara entity country strongly preferred
job.rawJd:
WHO WE ARE:
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations Cloud, a platform that helps organizations with physical operations use Internet of Things data to improve safety, efficiency, and sustainability. The platform supports industries including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing. Product areas include Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring.

ABOUT THE ROLE
As a Senior Product Designer at Samsara, you will provide design expertise and execution for strategic initiatives, delivering end-to-end experiences that affect customers and business objectives. You will own design for the AI and agentic workflows product area, shaping how the platform surfaces intelligent automation and decision-making for physical operations teams. You will collaborate closely with Product and Engineering, work directly with customers, influence strategy, and ship well-crafted designs.

YOU SHOULD APPLY IF
- You want to affect the industries that run our world.
- You are the architect of your own career and want room to experiment and develop your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
- You are energized by the opportunity to digitize large sectors of the global economy.
- You want to work with a high-calibre team.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
- Own the UX for a product area or surface, shipping designs that unlock customer and business value.
- Collaborate closely with product and engineering on strategy, planning, and execution.
- Work directly with customers to understand their needs, validate designs, and inform strategy.
- Provide expertise and knowledge transfer to Samsara's internal design team.
- Deliver agreed-upon project deliverables on time and to spec.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS
- 5+ years of product design experience designing UX/UI for web and mobile applications.
- Direct experience designing AI or agentic workflow products strongly preferred.
- Strong interaction and visual design skills.
- Portfolio and/or case studies showing design craft and the ability to solve user problems with quantified impact, required to be considered.
- Demonstrated proficiency with AI tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, and Figma Make.
- Experience prototyping in real codebases and comfort working in GitHub.
- Proven experience in fast-paced, high-growth environments.
- Strong cross-functional collaboration skills.

IDEAL CANDIDATE
- High craft with pragmatic, proactive execution.
- Comfortable with zero-to-one and early-stage work where the path is not fully defined.
- Self-directed and resourceful.
- Refined taste, strong product instincts, and a bias toward solving real customer problems.
- Curious, hands-on, and resilient, with the ability to move between strategy and polished execution.

CONTRACT DETAILS
Duration: 6 months, with conversion potential if based in a country where Samsara has legal entities.
Hours: 40 hours per week, no overtime.
Location: Fully remote.
Rate: $90-$110 per hour.
Start: ASAP.
Candidates based in a Samsara entity country are strongly preferred. Eligible countries are the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, France, Germany, Netherlands, Poland, India, Taiwan, and Mexico. All offers depend on the individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work in their respective country.
